$comment: 12 supply-chain priority regions at launch. geo_bbox is [south, west, north, east]. parent is UN M49 macro-region for grouping.

regions.name: Persian Gulf / Hormuz
regions.why_it_matters: Energy chokepoint; ~17 Mb/d crude + condensate, 20% global LNG

regions.name: Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb
regions.why_it_matters: Asia-Europe shipping chokepoint; Suez approach; Houthi targeting

regions.name: Malacca Strait
regions.why_it_matters: Asia-Europe shipping spine; ~30% global trade, 80% NE Asia crude imports

regions.name: Taiwan Strait
regions.why_it_matters: Geopolitical chokepoint; semiconductor concentration; ~88% of advanced-node fab capacity

regions.name: NW Pacific (CN/JP/KR)
regions.why_it_matters: Typhoon corridor; manufacturing concentration; rare-earths refining

regions.name: South Asia (IN/BD)
regions.why_it_matters: SW + NE monsoon; textiles concentration (BGD apparel); pharma API (IND)

regions.name: EU industrial corridor (DE/FR/BE/NL)
regions.why_it_matters: Chemicals + auto + FM concentration; Rhine logistics; ARA ports

regions.name: North Sea / Baltic
regions.why_it_matters: Windstorm corridor (Oct–Mar); North Sea oil/gas; offshore wind; Nord Stream successor infra

regions.name: Mediterranean / Suez approach
regions.why_it_matters: Suez chokepoint; LNG re-export hubs; refining capacity

regions.name: US Gulf / Houston
regions.why_it_matters: Atlantic hurricane landfall; ~50% US refining; LNG export hub; petchem concentration

regions.name: Panama Canal
regions.why_it_matters: Inter-ocean chokepoint; drought-sensitive draft restrictions; LNG / containers / dry bulk

regions.name: Arctic shipping (Northern Sea Route + Northwest Passage)
regions.why_it_matters: Emerging seasonal route; ice-window volatility; geopolitical contention
